messages:
Jordan: Quick debrief from today's all-hands reliability Q&A — thank you to folks who asked the hard questions. I want to capture clarifications and owners here so we can close the loop.
Priya: Two quick asks — 1) where's the RCA link? 2) who owns the mitigation timeline?
Sam: RCA is here: https://redwood.internal/rca/incident-2026-03-22 (note: internal access only). TL;DR: cache invalidation bug + a cascading retry pattern in the router.
Anika: I can own the short-term mitigation (rate-limiting hot keys + deploy fix). Estimated ETA: patch out by EOD Friday, rollout Monday morning canary->global.
Marcus: For the longer term, we need SLO clarity. During the all-hands someone asked if we keep the 95th target or tighten to 99th for latency. What's the expected decision path?
Jordan: Good point Marcus. Leadership will not move SLOs in isolation — we need a cross-team proposal. Priya, can you convene a 30m sync with eng-sre, platform, and product to produce a recommendation by next Wed?
Priya: Yep, will set up. Agenda: 1) incident summary, 2) cost vs. latency tradeoffs, 3) proposed SLO delta and rollout plan. I'll ping eng-sre for telemetry slices needed.
ops-bot: Incident page updated by Sam — https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-03122 — status: monitoring.
Sam: Adding two small debugging artifacts to the RCA: stack traces and the failing query snippet we used: ```grafana
sum(rate(http_request_errors{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (region)
```
Anika: I'll post the canary run plan in #eng-runtime and share the rollout checklist here once ready.
Marcus: Re: ownership — Anika for mitigation, Priya to run SLO sync, Sam for RCA closure & postmortem edits, Jordan to confirm executive communication and SLA notes. Sounds right?
Jordan: Yes. Also, a quick ask from leadership: please flag any customer-impacting contract issues to me directly. We'll prioritize Dedicated/Private customers on the mitigation path.
Priya: Scheduling that SLO sync now, invite to follow.
Sam: Will update RCA with owners and close the loop once Anika confirms patch verification.
Anika: Patch is in review. Small note — the fix turned up an unrelated flaky test; I'll coordinate with test infra to quarantine so rollout stays green.
Marcus: +1 on quarantining tests. Also, can we add a quick dashboard card for hot-key retries? I can take that on if eng-telemetry approves.
Jordan: Excellent. Thank you all. I'll follow up with a leadership blurb tomorrow for customer comms. If anyone else needs to be added as an owner, reply here. :thumbsup:
